description:
Use this when the user asks what a graded (slabbed) copy of one card is worth, or
    how much more a PSA 10 sells for than a raw copy. Returns PriceCharting's values from
    sold listings for each grade it has (PSA 10, BGS 10, CGC 10, SGC 10, TAG 10 and
    grades 7, 8, 9 and 9.5 from any grader), its ungraded value, how many times the
    ungraded value a PSA 10 sells for, the date, and the credit 'Prices from
    PriceCharting' with a link to the card's PriceCharting page, which goes with any
    value quoted. Singles only; needs a product_id from search_cards.
name: graded_price
title: Graded card prices
